entities.name: Nylah
entities.description: An ambitious initiate who, as the city falls, comes to believe fully and gives herself to the Eternals.

entities.name: Asenue
entities.description: A two-blade master who fights two Eternals to protect others, mentally repeating the mantra one more breath.

entities.name: Genub
entities.description: A young man who searches for his lover Makare and is killed by her after she is turned into an Eternal.

entities.name: Makare
entities.description: Genub's lover, who becomes a blue-eyed Eternal and kills him.

entities.name: Kawit
entities.description: A devoted warrior of Oketra who attacks the God-Pharaoh with one of Oketra's arrows.

entities.name: Amenakhte
entities.description: A large man who shields a child with his body and dies after handing him to a woman.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The returned dragon God-Pharaoh with a golden egg between his horns, who dismisses Kawit.

entities.name: The Scarab God
entities.description: A scarab-shaped dark god who leads the Eternals out of the central mausoleum.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The dead archer god whose divine arrow Kawit wields and whose power shields her.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A dead god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A dead god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A dead god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: The Eternals
entities.description: An army of undead champions coated in blue lazotep who slaughter the citizens of Naktamun.

entities.name: Bakenptah
entities.description: A minotaur past champion whom Nylah recognizes among the Eternals.

entities.name: Taweret
entities.description: A mighty mage past champion whom Nylah recognizes among the Eternals.

entities.name: The Angels
entities.description: Angels in the sky who overlook the chaos and announce that the Eternals come.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The fourth Hour, in which the Eternals emerge to slaughter Naktamun's citizens.

entities.name: Central Mausoleum
entities.description: The repository of the worthy dead whose gates open to release the Eternals.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city overrun by the Eternals.

entities.name: The Luxa
entities.description: The river that now runs blood red with fish corpses.

events.summary: Nylah, once indifferent to faith, finally believes as the city is destroyed and the gods die, and welcomes the horror as her Trial.
Angels announce the Eternals come and the gates of the central mausoleum open.
The scarab god leads thousands of blue-glazed Eternals, including past champions, out of the mausoleum.
events.quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

events.summary: Nylah is swarmed by the Eternals and gladly killed, crying that she now believes.
events.quote: Each blade sunk into her flesh with a cold kiss

events.summary: Asenue holds off two Eternals to give others time to escape, though she knows she will lose.
events.quote: Every moment she stayed alive, that was another person not dying

events.summary: Asenue falters in mid-breath, implying her death.
events.quote: One more breath. One more breath. One. More. Brea —

events.summary: Genub and Makare flee together from the Eternals, but Genub loses her in the chaos.
events.quote: When next he stopped to breathe, Makare was not there.

events.summary: Genub finds Makare, now an Eternal with glowing blue eyes, who cuts him down as he reaches for her.
events.quote: Hers was not the only blade that punctured his flesh, but it was the first.

events.summary: Kawit, enraged at Oketra's death, takes one of her arrows as a spear and destroys a minotaur Eternal.
events.quote: There was a flash of white light as the minotaur disintegrated

events.summary: Kawit sees the dragon God-Pharaoh and realizes he is no impostor but the being they served.
events.quote: This dragon is not an impostor. This dragon is our God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
Kawit's shield fails and the Eternals close in on her.
events.quote: The Eternals closed in, and Kawit did not have strength enough left to scream.

events.summary: Amenakhte, mortally wounded after shielding a child with his body, begs a human woman to save the child and dies.
events.quote: all that Amenakhte had time to do was put himself between the falling blades and the child

events.summary: The woman promises Amenakhte that she will save the child as he dies.
